notes:
Quick CRM notes / highlights:
- Account: mid-tier trading firm + retail wealth platform. Heavy real-time and compliance constraints.
- Primary contact: CTO (Anya Bennett) + Head of Infra (Leo Marsh). Procurement lead: Simon Ortega.
- Use-case summary: customer/chat assistant for traders (low-latency), synoptic embeddings for search, reranking for alerts pipeline. P95 latency SLOs: <=250ms on 512-token flows; throughput target ~300 req/s peak.
- Capacity ask: reserved GPUs for baseline + burst. Initial config proposed: 8x A100-equivalent nodes in primary region + 2x spare for failover. Want committed throughput guarantees.
- SLA asks from customer: 99.95% uptime minimum; legal pushing 99.99% (see call). Wants clear credit schedule (scales by minutes/hours of downtime) not just % credit on invoices. Wants removal of force-majeure loopholes for short planned maintenance.
- Maintenance windows: customer acceptable to monthly 2-hour maintenance windows in off-peak (00:00-02:00 local), but wants no more than 6 such windows/year and advance notice >=14 days.
- Support expectations: P1 response <=15 minutes (24/7), P2 <=1 hour, on-call escalation path to SE + AE. Wants optional dedicated SL ack channel + phone escalation.
- Network/peering: costs are a sticking point — transit estimate higher than expected. They asked for a transit cost cap in contract or offset credit.
- Security: SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention 7 years for certain datasets, EU data residency for subset of customers. Need SOC2 + the Redwood security FAQ + encryption whitepaper.
- Pricing sensitivity: prefers annual committed spend; targeting $300-600k ARR. Interested in committed reserved pricing with burst credits.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictability — not best-effort. If you promise a throughput, we need it measured and credited."
- Attachments: SLA draft v2 (drive link), throughput run results (drive), legal redlines pending.
- Open questions: how credits calculated (per-minute vs per-incident), how rollback / automatic fallback to hosted API handled during extended outage, included bandwidth allowances, and whether specific AZ reservations can be guaranteed.
- Sales note: prioritize legal + infra review; schedule on-site tech deep-dive after SOW signed.
